features: 3D SURROUND SOUND: The MZ M51 soundbar delivers immersive Hi-Fi audio performance with loud and clear 3D surround sound for an enhanced home theatre experience.
WIRELESS BLUETOOTH CONNECTIVITY: Connects wirelessly via Bluetooth to your TV, PC, laptop, mobile, and tablet for seamless and cable-free audio streaming.
MULTIPLE INPUT OPTIONS: Supports USB playback, AUX input, TF card slot, and built-in FM radio, giving you versatile ways to enjoy your favourite music.
EASY AUDIO CONTROLS: Intuitive on-board buttons for Play/Pause, Volume +/-, and a Mode button to switch between Bluetooth, USB, TF Card, and AUX input sources.
LONG BATTERY LIFE: Built-in rechargeable battery with long-lasting performance, powered via DC 5V, making it suitable for both home and portable use.
description: Elevate your home audio experience with the MZ M51 Wireless Soundbar, a sleek and powerful addition to your living space. Designed for TVs, laptops, PCs, mobiles, and tablets, this versatile soundbar delivers immersive 3D surround sound with loud and clear Hi-Fi audio performance that transforms the way you enjoy music, movies, and more. Connectivity is effortless with multiple input options including Wireless Bluetooth, USB playback, AUX input, TF Card support, and built-in FM Radio, ensuring compatibility with virtually all your devices. The intuitive on-board controls let you play, pause, skip tracks, adjust volume, and switch input modes with ease. Its compact, stylish design with a premium fabric grille makes it a perfect fit for any home setup. Backed by a long battery life, the MZ M51 keeps the entertainment going for extended sessions without interruption. Whether you are upgrading your TV audio or enhancing your desktop setup, this soundbar is a reliable and feature-rich choice.
